rules.title: Security deposit cap: one month's rent
rules.requirement: A landlord may not demand or receive a security deposit (however named, including fees for processing a new tenant) of more than one month's rent, in addition to first month's rent. Leases may not label any deposit "nonrefundable."
rules.requirement_es: El arrendador no puede exigir ni recibir un depósito de garantía (con cualquier nombre) superior a un mes de renta, además de la renta del primer mes. Los contratos no pueden llamar a ningún depósito "no reembolsable".
rules.quoted_span: a landlord shall not demand or receive security, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of an amount equal to one month’s rent, in addition to any rent for the first month paid on or before initial occupancy.
rules.effective_date_quote: This subdivision shall not apply to a security collected or demanded by the landlord before July 1, 2024.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental property used as the tenant's dwelling.
rules.exemptions: Advance payment of six months' rent or more for leases of six months or longer; agreed tenant-requested alterations for a fee; two-month cap for small natural-person landlords (separate rule).
rules.penalty: Bad-faith retention may lead to statutory damages up to twice the deposit plus actual damages (subd. (m)).

rules.title: Small-landlord security deposit cap: two months' rent
rules.requirement: A landlord who is a natural person (or an LLC of natural persons) and owns no more than two rental properties with no more than four units total may charge up to two months' rent as security. This higher cap does not apply if the prospective tenant is a service member.
rules.requirement_es: Un arrendador que sea persona física (o una LLC de personas físicas) y tenga no más de dos propiedades con un máximo de cuatro unidades en total puede cobrar hasta dos meses de renta como depósito. Este límite no se aplica si el inquilino es miembro del servicio militar.
rules.quoted_span: Notwithstanding paragraph (1), a landlord shall not demand or receive security, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of an amount equal to two months’ rent, in addition to any rent for the first month paid on or before initial occupancy
rules.effective_date_quote: This subdivision shall not apply to a security collected or demanded by the landlord before July 1, 2024.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlord is a natural person or LLC whose members are all natural persons, and owns no more than two residential rental properties with no more than four dwelling units offered for rent collectively.
rules.exemptions: Not applicable if the prospective tenant is a service member.

rules.title: Deposit return and itemized statement within 21 days
rules.requirement: Within 21 calendar days after the tenant moves out, the landlord must send an itemized statement of deductions and return any remaining deposit. Deductions are limited to unpaid rent, damage beyond ordinary wear and tear, and necessary cleaning, and the landlord must provide photos and receipts for repairs.
rules.requirement_es: Dentro de 21 días calendario después de que el inquilino se mude, el arrendador debe enviar un estado de cuenta detallado y devolver el resto del depósito. Las deducciones se limitan a renta impaga, daños más allá del desgaste normal y limpieza necesaria, y debe proporcionar fotos y recibos.
rules.quoted_span: the landlord shall furnish the tenant, a copy of an itemized statement indicating the basis for, and the amount of, any security received and the disposition of the security, and shall return any remaining portion of the security to the tenant as follows:
rules.effective_date_quote: (Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 340, Sec. 1.   (AB 414)   Effective January 1, 2026.)
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental property used as the tenant's dwelling.
rules.exemptions: Itemization/receipts not required if deductions for repairs and cleaning total $125 or less or tenant validly waived; initial inspection duties do not apply to certain unlawful detainer terminations.
rules.penalty: Landlord acting in bad faith loses the right to claim any of the deposit; statutory damages up to twice the deposit (subd. (h)(7), (m)).
rules.caveat: Effective date shown is that of the latest amendment (AB 414); the 21-day rule itself predates it.
